_comment: An example add-on: a mod that needs another mod. Copy this folder and example-mod into user-content/ to try it. Without example-mod, this mod is refused and the MODS tab says why.
name: Example Mod Add-on
author: OB64: Another World
description: Builds on Example Mod: its Iron Soldiers also get more VIT. It requires example-mod, so it always loads after it and wins where both change the same record.
